title: fusion.explorer-envelope/v1
description: The module's answer to a fusion.explorer.v1 invocation, the asset Prior selects as EnvelopeSchema (internal/fusionhost/external_explorer.go at 8bab88a). Exactly two members. domain is the module's own verdict: completed carries the role's result, which the host validates against the profile's result_schema and the findings limit; refused and recovery-required carry a null result, the latter when the role stands at accepted or a required audit is missing or invalid, never a fabricated audit or a fresh inference (Prior answer 67.5). host_evidence is the module's report of the host's own observations, copied from the role answer, or null when no answer exists, as for an accepted role; it is not independent evidence, and the host checks it against the pinned run (67.6). completed requires a settled role with host evidence present, and a refused or recovery-required answer cannot certify settlement. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

result.description: On completed, the stored role answer, valid against schemas/explorer-result.v1.json with at most findings_limit findings; otherwise null.

violations.description: Why the answer is not completed; empty on completed.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339, as the host's role answer serialises its time.

role_state.description: The role state the host reported when the answer was read.
